exams.title: Final Examination
exams.notes: Face-to-face; covers all course content; open to all students with no restriction

exams.title: Make-up Exam
exams.notes: Covers all course content; for students with documented excuses for one missed exam

grading.notes: No restrictions to be eligible for the final exam
Must complete all experiments and average >= 50; missing one experiment or average < 50 results in NA
Attendance >= 60% receives proportional grade (1-5); below 60% receives 0
Bonus points; score of 50-100 gives 1-3 bonus points proportionally

textbooks: Giancoli, Physics for Scientists and Engineers with Modern Physics, Global Edition, 5th Edition
extracted.summary: PHYS 105 (General Physics I) covers fundamental introductory physics topics supported by face-to-face theoretical lectures and laboratory experiments. The course evaluation consists of two midterms (25% each), a comprehensive final exam (35%), laboratory work (10%), attendance (5%), and up to 3% bonus for online homework.
